name: Somita Kalar
source:
Somita is a Kalar warrior that appeared exclusively in Kichikuou Rance, eventually being retconned into [url=/c741]Aegis Kalar[/url].

In Kichikuou Rance she was the captain of the Kalar Knights, dedicated to protecting the Kalar Forest of Pencilcow from invaders. [spoiler]She and her soldiers caught Rance when he was wandering through the forest in search of women and imprison him for use as a captive "breeding" male.[/spoiler] She's a childhood friend of Queen [url=/c98160]Pastel Kalar[/url] and her personal body-guard as well, being very protective of her.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Somita_Kalar]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
